description: C57 — 重复走子等于放弃先手

intro.popup_en: Rapid Development, Lesson 4: Make each move efficient. Moving the same piece repeatedly before developing others wastes tempi.
intro.popup:
快速出子第4课
每步棋都要稳妥高效，重复走同一个子等于浪费先手

outro.popup_en: Avoiding unnecessary repeated moves is central to rapid development.
outro.popup: 总结：不重复走子是快速出子的核心原则

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game.
moves.popup: e4开局

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's move.
moves.popup: e5对称

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops the knight for the first time and attacks e5, a sound opening move.
moves.popup:
Nf3！马第1次出动
正确发展，攻击e5

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops Black's first minor piece.
moves.popup:
Nc6发展
黑方第1个轻子

moves.popup_en: Bc4 develops White's second minor piece in the Italian Game.
moves.popup:
Bc4象出动
白方第2个轻子，意大利开局

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops Black's second minor piece and attacks e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展
黑方第2个轻子，攻击e4

moves.popup_en: Ng5?! White moves the same knight a second time, from f3 to g5, threatening f7. Developing a new piece with Nc3 would be more efficient.
moves.popup:
Ng5！⚠️ 白马第2次移动（f3→g5）
马跳向g5，威胁f7
但这是同一匹马！
正确应走Nc3发展新子

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black counterattacks in the center. When a knight jumps forward, challenge it with a pawn and open the position.
moves.popup:
d5！黑方反击！
每次有马跳入，就用兵反击
打开中心，赶走威胁

moves.popup_en: exd5 captures the pawn.
moves.popup: exd5吃兵

moves.popup_en: ...Na5! Black develops while attacking White's bishop.
moves.popup:
Na5！追击象
黑方继续发展，追击白方象

moves.popup_en: Bb5+ gives check, moving White's bishop for a second time from c4 to b5.
moves.popup:
Bb5+将军
白象走第2次（c4→b5）

moves.popup_en: ...c6 blocks the check and continues Black's active play.
moves.popup:
c6挡将
黑方步步有力

moves.popup_en: dxc6 captures the pawn.
moves.popup: dxc6吃兵

moves.popup_en: ...bxc6 recaptures.
moves.popup: bxc6接回

moves.popup_en: Be2 retreats the bishop for its third move: c4-b5-e2. The bishop has also lost tempi instead of allowing new pieces to develop.
moves.popup:
Be2象退回
白象走了3次（c4→b5→e2）
象也在浪费先手！

moves.popup_en: ...h6 attacks the knight on g5 and forces it to decide where to go.
moves.popup:
h6！追马
黑方逼退g5的马！

moves.popup_en: Nf3 is White's third move with the knight: f3-g5-f3. It returns to its starting square after spending three tempi, while Black used the time to develop.
moves.popup:
Nf3！⚠️ 白马第3次移动！（f3→g5→f3）
马走了圈，回到原地！
这3步几乎等于白走
黑方利用这时间完成了更多发展

moves.popup_en: ...e4 advances and gains space, using Black's lead in tempi.
moves.popup:
e4推兵
黑方推兵争夺空间，利用节奏优势

moves.popup_en: Ne5 centralizes White's knight in an attempt to become active.
moves.popup:
Ne5马跳中心
白方尝试激活

moves.popup_en: ...Bd6 develops Black's bishop.
moves.popup:
Bd6发展
黑方继续出子

moves.popup_en: d4 advances in the center.
moves.popup: d4推进

moves.popup_en: ...exd3 exchanges pawns.
moves.popup: exd3兑换

moves.popup_en: Nxd3 recaptures. The route Nf3-g5-f3 used three moves to return the knight to its original square, effectively wasting two tempi. Black's development lead shows the cost of repeated moves.
moves.popup:
Nxd3
总结：Nf3→Ng5→Nf3 = 马走3步回原地
等于浪费2个先手
黑方发展领先，这就是节奏损失的代价！
